prompts.prompt:

空間は個人的な空間として感じられる。ボケはカメラの限界によるもので、人工的な被写界深度効果ではない。全体的な雰囲気は温かく、明るく、親密で、被写体が話し始める直前のリアルなVlogの瞬間を思わせる。

prompts.title: 空灵 8K 肖像，配以九重葛花朵提示

prompts.prompt: An ethereal 8K portrait capturing a young Asian woman surrounded by cascading pink bougainvillea blossoms. She wears a blush-toned tailored top styled with high-waisted black denim, creating a soft yet modern contrast. Her complexion glows naturally with a hint of rosy makeup, complemented by a calm, effortless smile. Silky black hair moves gently with the breeze, adding life to the frame. Bathed in warm pastel hues and golden daylight, the image features a dreamy shallow focus, velvety background blur, and refined cinematic lighting. The overall mood feels elegant, feminine, and visually enchanting with ultra-high-definition clarity.
